cases.goal: File name path characters are sanitized; the same file obtains the same ID
cases.steps: Offer ../../secret?.bin twice, size 4, same fingerprint
cases.expected: File name contains no path or question mark; IDs are identical for both offers
cases.actual: Sanitized file name is secret_.bin, both IDs match

cases.goal: File size boundary checks and invalid SHA-256 fingerprint validation
cases.steps: Offer files of size 0, 1, 20GiB, 20GiB+1, and an invalid SHA-256 hash
cases.expected: Size 0, oversized files and invalid fingerprints are rejected; 1-byte and 20GiB offers succeed
cases.actual: Zero-byte, oversized and invalid-fingerprint offers are rejected; 1-byte and 20GiB offers can be created

cases.goal: Non-friends cannot send files; receivers cannot initiate transmission on behalf of sender
cases.pre: Two users are not mutual friends
cases.steps: Send file offer to non-friend; receiver calls file.start
cases.actual: Offer to non-friend rejected; receiver cannot invoke file.start

cases.goal: Incomplete transfer cannot be finished; canceled transfer cannot be downloaded as completed
cases.pre: An accepted but unfinished file transfer exists
cases.steps: Call finish directly; cancel transfer; attempt download
cases.expected: finish fails; state becomes canceled after cancel; download returns 409
cases.actual: finish on incomplete transfer rejected; download returns 409 after cancellation

cases.goal: Re-offer with identical metadata after cancellation clears old progress
cases.pre: Previous file with same fingerprint was canceled in FN-FILE-04
cases.steps: Re-offer with same metadata and start transfer
cases.expected: confirmed offset resets to 0, transfer ready to restart
cases.actual: Confirmed offset resets to zero after re-offer

cases.goal: The same file cannot be sent concurrently from two client windows
cases.pre: Alice has two active connections; file offer is accepted
cases.steps: Call file.start from both connections
cases.expected: The second start request is rejected
cases.actual: Transmission from the second window is rejected

cases.goal: Sender and receiver may download completed file; third parties cannot
cases.steps: Download by sender, receiver and an unrelated third user after completion
cases.expected: Sender and receiver get 200 response with matching bytes; third party gets 404
cases.actual: Sender and receiver download content 'Z'; outsider receives 404; completed file cannot be canceled

cases.goal: Offer generates valid file ID
cases.steps: Offer an approximately 3MB file
cases.actual: Offer generates 32-byte file ID, state = offered

cases.goal: Transmission cannot start before receiver accepts offer
cases.steps: Invoke file.start
cases.actual: Transmission cannot start before receiver accepts

cases.goal: Server confirms received offset after partial upload
cases.pre: Receiver has accepted the file offer
cases.steps: Send 1507328 bytes
cases.expected: confirmed value equals uploaded byte count
cases.actual: 1507328 bytes sent; server confirmed offset = 1507328

cases.goal: Confirmed offset persists after sender disconnects
cases.steps: Close sender connection
cases.actual: State changes to interrupted after sender disconnect; confirmed offset retained

cases.goal: Transfer record remains available after reconnection
cases.steps: Reconnect using original token
cases.expected: Confirmed offset 1507328 is returned in hello message
cases.actual: Confirmed offset is preserved in transfer record after reconnection

cases.goal: Data blocks with wrong offset are rejected
cases.steps: Intentionally send block starting from incorrect offset
cases.expected: Server replies with correct resume offset
cases.actual: Misaligned block rejected; server responds with valid offset

cases.goal: SHA-256 hash matches after resume completes
cases.steps: Send remaining bytes and call finish
cases.actual: Transfer finished after resume; server-side SHA-256 matches original file

cases.goal: Sum of bytes from two sessions equals total file size
cases.steps: Check starting offset and bytes sent in second session
cases.actual: A(1507328) + B(1650745) = 3158073; B is far smaller than full file size

cases.goal: Downloaded content on receiver side is identical to original file
cases.steps: GET /api/files/:id
cases.actual: Bytes downloaded by receiver exactly match original file

cases.goal: Unrelated users cannot download the file
cases.pre: Carol is not the sender or receiver
cases.steps: Carol tries to download the file
cases.actual: Unauthorized third user download blocked

cases.goal: Transfer rejected if final hash mismatches declared fingerprint
cases.pre: An incorrect SHA-256 fingerprint was declared
cases.steps: Complete transfer and call finish
cases.actual: Content SHA-256 inconsistent with declared hash; state set to failed

cases.goal: Files failing hash check are not stored in received directory
cases.steps: Inspect received folder
cases.actual: Failed file is not saved into received directory

cases.goal: Size of partial temporary file on disk matches ledger confirmed offset
cases.pre: Partial bytes written and connection closed
cases.steps: Compare partial file size and confirmed offset in ledger
cases.actual: Size of partial file on disk matches confirmed offset stored in ledger
